description:
Adds the `gf2-coding` owner producer of the offline tuning system, which measures the decode selector fields of the coding tuning section.

## Background

The offline tuning system calibrates selectors through an owner producer, `crates/<owner>/benches/tuning_calibration.rs`, run by `dev/scripts/tuning-extent-campaign.sh` from a committed campaign declaration: the neutral driver stages and journals the campaign, the composer writes a versioned owner envelope whose measurement block carries the producer's behaviour token and executable digest, and an independent validator accepts the published stage. `gf2-core` and `gf2-algebra` are owners; `gf2-coding` has an owner codec and no producer. The batch soft-decoder trait of `gf2-coding` decodes a batch of LLR frames into caller-provided decoded words and per-frame outcomes in input order. Its LDPC implementer, the LDPC batch decoder, decodes fixed waves of eight lanes with per-frame termination, routes a wave to the lane kernels or to the single-frame decoder by the decode selectors of the coding tuning section, and returns each frame's result equal to the single-frame decoder's bit for bit as `docs/reference/ldpc-decoder-numerical-contract.md` states. The decode selectors are `lane_min_frames`, `lane_max_edges` and `granules_per_task`; their conservative values route each frame to the single-frame decoder.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-coding/benches/tuning_calibration.rs` implements the owner operations of the offline tuning campaign, capability report, grid listing, self-check, guarded fresh-child measurement and owner emission, for the decode selector fields, with a behaviour token equal to the harness schema the coding owner codec accepts.
- [hard] REQ-02: A case times whole batch decode calls with lane transposition in and out and workspace reuse inside the call, over a declared grid of occupied-lane counts, codes of different edge counts and waves per task.
- [hard] REQ-03: Case inputs derive from the campaign seed derivation, and the grid listing states the calibration inventory of codes, seeds and batch sizes so a later holdout can avoid it.
- [hard] REQ-04: A field whose candidates do not win under the campaign's extent decision is omitted from the emitted section, so its conservative value stands, and an emitted section round-trips through the owner codec.
- [hard] REQ-05: A harness test runs the self-check and the grid listing untimed; only a guarded fresh child installs tuning.
- [hard] REQ-06: The harness holds its declared protocol constants and no typed timing figure or host condition.

## Notes

The producer follows the structure of the `gf2-algebra` producer and uses the shared campaign-support library; it adds no private campaign framework.
title: Produce decode selector measurements from a coding owner harness
